assertions.title: Lists locally downloaded models with disk size and quant
assertions.reason: `mlx-stack models` listed local model directories with human-readable disk sizes (5.2 GB, 2.3 GB), quant values (int4/int8), and source type column.

steps.action: Create local model directories with sparse weight files in assigned MLX_STACK_HOME/models
steps.expected: Model scan should detect local directories and compute display sizes/quantization
steps.observed: Two local entries were shown with sizes `5.2 GB` and `2.3 GB`, quants `int4` and `int8`, and source values `unknown`/`mlx-community`.

assertions.title: Active stack models marked with indicator
assertions.reason: Output marked stack-active local model with `✓`, left non-stack local model unmarked, and showed a remote-only stack model with `remote` source plus estimated size `4.5 GB`.

steps.action: Create `stacks/default.yaml` referencing one downloaded model and one undownloaded model
steps.expected: Downloaded stack model should be marked active; undownloaded stack model should appear as remote with estimated size
steps.observed: `Qwen 3.5 8B` local row had `✓`; non-stack local nemotron row had no indicator; `DeepSeek R1 8B` appeared in `Stack Models (not downloaded)` with `remote` source and `4.5 GB` estimated size.

assertions.title: No local models produces informative message
assertions.reason: On an empty assigned MLX_STACK_HOME, `mlx-stack models` returned exit code 0 and displayed `No models found` plus guidance to run `mlx-stack pull` or `mlx-stack init`.

steps.action: Run `models` before creating any model directory
steps.expected: Helpful no-models guidance with suggested next commands
steps.observed: Output: `No models found. Run mlx-stack pull ... or mlx-stack init ...` and exit code 0.

assertions.title: Custom model-dir configuration respected
assertions.reason: After `config set model-dir <custom>`, `models` scanned and reported only the custom directory content and printed the custom models path in footer.
commands: MLX_STACK_HOME=/tmp/mlx-stack-user-testing/recommendation/g6-models-local uv run mlx-stack config set model-dir /tmp/mlx-stack-user-testing/recommendation/g6-models-local/custom-models

steps.expected: Subsequent `models` command should scan custom path instead of default
steps.observed: Output listed `Custom-Model-4bit` from custom dir and footer showed `Models directory: /tmp/mlx-stack-user-testing/recommendation/g6-models-local/custom-models`.

frictions.description: Fixture setup via system `python3` lacked PyYAML (`ModuleNotFoundError: yaml`).
frictions.resolution: Used `MLX_STACK_HOME=... uv run python` for fixture generation so project dependencies were available.

summary: Tested 4 assigned assertions (VAL-MODELS-001/002/003/006) via CLI in isolated MLX_STACK_HOME; all 4 passed.
